scope: Thirty-seven remaining audited non--aju third-person-plural verb forms missing final t: 29 in papers 1-43 and eight in book 44.
choice: Add the required final t at exact line-and-occurrence locators while preserving stem, aspect, spelling, capitalization, clause, and mathematical meaning.
motivation: Official morphology distinguishes first-person singular -u from third-person plural -ut. Every changed occurrence has an overt plural subject or antecedent. Locator-level application is required because one line contains a protected singular mogu followed later by a plural mogu.
alternatives_rejected: Replace every bare -u form globally: that would corrupt genuine first-person-singular authorial predicates.
Treat final t as optional: this conflicts with the official third-person-plural paradigm and EDIT-0059's accepted repair.
Normalize lexical stems simultaneously: this would conflate exact agreement repair with separate lexical decisions.

official_verb_grammar.relevance: The paradigm distinguishes first-person singular -u from third-person plural -ut.

context_review.finding: All 37 mapped clauses have plural subjects or antecedents.

validation.protected_forms: all eight singular holds remain, including only the second mogu changed on base line 22510
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, protected fragments, and line counts unchanged
validation.reproducibility: Frozen output hashes reproduced immediately before atomic apply
